discrepancies.summary: Global, training, and out-of-scope-hero Exsp rows have no package column.
discrepancies.provisionalDecision: Include only Exsp rows whose HERO points to a selected package-1 or package-2 hero; keep the remainder excluded until scenario evidence requires one.

discrepancies.summary: Rune, Five, Ops, and Aas have no legacy package ownership column.
discrepancies.provisionalDecision: Treat these runtime rule/configuration rows as shared core and verify their actual dependencies during P04 semantics work.

discrepancies.summary: VALID/COUNT and GENRE encode different package concerns and cannot substitute for each other.
discrepancies.provisionalDecision: Use Card.Level2Pkg plus VALID/COUNT for enabled scope, then GENRE 1/2 for standard/fengmingyushi product ownership as shown by the old package UI.

discrepancies.summary: The prior scope.md calls the two fengmingyushi forms 龙葵 and 龙葵鬼, while the database calls them 龙葵·蓝 and 龙葵·红.
discrepancies.provisionalDecision: Use database names as canonical display names and retain the scope.md names as searchable aliases.
